cases.name: Luna 主控只读快照
cases.command: printf 'node='; hostname; printf 'cores='; nproc; printf 'time='; date '+%F %T %z'

cases.name: Luna 语音/视觉节点只读快照
cases.command: printf 'node='; hostname; printf 'cores='; nproc; printf 'services='; ps -eo comm= | grep -E 'AudioDeviceNode|speech_playback|GestureMrosNode|mroswebvideo' | sort -u | paste -sd, - || true
